errors.connectionRefused: The server refused the connection. Check the address and port.
errors.serverNotFound: Server not found. Check that the address is correct.
errors.timeout: The server is not responding (connection timed out). Check the address, port, and network connection.
errors.connectionReset: The connection to the server was unexpectedly closed.
errors.networkUnreachable: The server is unreachable — check your network connection.
errors.invalidCertificate: The server presented an invalid certificate. If you trust this server, disable certificate verification in the connection settings.
errors.tlsNegotiationFailed: TLS negotiation failed. Check that the server supports explicit FTPS or HTTPS and a compatible TLS version.
errors.sshNegotiationFailed: SSH negotiation failed. The server and FTPeach could not agree on a compatible SSH algorithm or protocol version.
errors.proxyFailed: The proxy connection failed. Check the proxy type, address, credentials, and whether it can reach the target server.
errors.keyReadFailed: Couldn't read the key — the file is corrupted or the passphrase is incorrect.
errors.accessDenied: You don't have permission for this operation.
errors.fileOrFolderExists: A file or folder with that name already exists.
errors.fileBusy: The file is in use by another process.
errors.hostKeyMismatch: The server host key has changed.
errors.integrityMismatch: The transferred file failed the integrity check.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Click a shortcut, then press a new key combination to reassign it.

security.title: Password protection
security.systemModeHint: Passwords are encrypted for your Windows account and can be viewed in connection settings.
security.strongholdModeHint: Requires a master password. Viewing a saved password requires master-password reauthentication.
security.configuredLocked: Protected storage is secured with a master password and locked.
security.configuredUnlocked: Protected storage is secured with a master password and unlocked.
security.unlockRequiredHint: This connection uses a saved secret. Unlock protected storage to continue.
security.autoLockHint: Locks protected storage after inactivity. Existing server connections remain active; 0 disables auto-lock.
security.systemUnlockHint: Uses Windows Hello (PIN, face, or fingerprint as configured by Windows). Your master password remains the recovery method.
security.systemUnavailable: System unlock is unavailable on this platform.
security.noRecovery: A forgotten master password cannot be recovered. Resetting the vault deletes all saved secrets.
security.passwordTooShort: Use at least 12 characters for the master password.

strength.tooShort: Too short — use at least 12 characters.
strength.acceptable: Acceptable. A longer passphrase is safer.

security.resetHint: Deletes protected storage and every password and SSH key passphrase stored in it. Enhanced protection will need to be set up again.
security.resetWarning: This permanently deletes every saved password and key passphrase. Enter the current master password to continue.
security.showConfirmationsHint: Ask before revealing saved secrets or running executable files. Resetting protected storage always requires confirmation.

settings.connectTimeoutHint: How long to wait for a server response when connecting before considering it unreachable (0 or blank — no limit). Applies to the next connection.
settings.ftpActiveModeHint: FTP/FTPS only — has no effect on SFTP/WebDAV. Rarely needed, only on networks/servers where passive mode doesn't get through NAT. Applies to the next connection.
settings.ftpActiveModeDisabledByProxy: Unavailable while a proxy is enabled — a proxy tunnel only supports outbound connections, so FTP has to stay in passive mode.

proxy.enableHint: SOCKS4, SOCKS5, or HTTP CONNECT — applies to FTP, FTPS, SFTP, and WebDAV. Applies to the next connection.
proxy.revealFailed: Could not decrypt the saved password.
proxy.testOk: The proxy reached the target successfully.

settings.concurrencyHint: How many files to upload and download at the same time (0 or blank — no limit). Applies to the next connection.
settings.speedLimitHint: Applies to the combined total of all simultaneous transfers (0 or blank — no limit). Takes effect immediately, without waiting for the next connection.
settings.notifyOnCompleteHint: A system notification when the transfer queue empties out — only while the window is not focused.
settings.overwriteHint: What to do when the file being copied already exists in the destination folder.
settings.preventSleep: Prevent the system from sleeping during transfers
settings.preventSleepHint: Takes effect immediately, without waiting for the next connection. Active as long as there's at least one ongoing transfer — doesn't block sleep otherwise.
settings.interfaceScaleHint: Change the size of text and controls throughout the application.
settings.defaultLocalPathHint: The folder the Computer pane opens to on startup and when switching from a server. Leave blank to use your system's home folder.
settings.showHiddenFilesHint: Applies to both local and remote file panes.
settings.coloredTabsHint: Colors the tab name and icon using the saved bookmark color.
settings.autoCheckUpdatesHint: A silent check a few seconds after startup — installing an update always requires separate confirmation.
settings.autoReconnectTabsHint: Off by default. When enabled, restored saved sites are connected automatically.
settings.saveSessionOnExitHint: Restores open tabs, pane types and paths on the next launch. Turning this off clears the saved session.

updateStatus.notPackaged: Not available in this build (npm run dev/start).

settings.logToFileHint: Continuously appends the log to a file on disk (%APPDATA%\FTPeach\logs\ftpeach.log) while enabled — regardless of whether the log panel is open. This is different from the "Save" button in the panel itself (that one saves only the last 200 lines once, on click).
settings.exportDiagnosticsHint: Exports version, OS and the latest 200 log records. Passwords, tokens and other secrets are redacted.
settings.exportDiagnosticsFailed: Could not export the diagnostic bundle.
